notes.title: Death end re;Quest NOW AVAILABLE with a Deluxe Pack!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32763017/912224474dd999c2d2b88a6e6c4aeb5c90bfc5df.png

Log into World's Oddsey today! We're happy to announce that Death end re;Quest™  is NOW AVAILABLE for $49.99 on Steam® with a Deluxe Pack (purchased separately)! There is a WEEKLONG 20% OFF discount on both the game and Deluxe Pack! Users can save an additional 20% with the Deluxe Bundle (Game + Deluxe Pack) which has a permanent 20% OFF DISCOUNT. 

The game includes all the original game content found in the Japanese and Western releases and will also include English, Japanese, and Traditional Chinese subtitles.

Steam users can grab the free and paid DLC originally available on the PlayStation®4 version. The Summer Swimsuit Bundle (FREE) will be available to download on June 4.
*PlayStation™Network & Physical Retail Exclusives bonus weapon DLC will not be included in the Steam release.

Death end re;Quest™ takes the classic turn-based RPG and turns it on its head, allowing you to jump at will between the RPG action of the game world, and the investigative visual novel segments of the real world. You'll need to explore both to unearth the mysteries of the game. In the game world, you'll fight engaging RPG battles where you can create chain reaction attacks with the right angles, and even switch game genres from RPG into fighting, shooting, slot, puzzle, and billiards! In the realm of game development, it may seem all fun and games until the lines between fantasy and reality begin to blur. 

Check out the Deluxe Pack contents below!

Deluxe Pack ($9.99):
The Death end re;Quest Deluxe Pack will be available for purchase separately and includes:

 Character Art Collection
 Concept Art Collection
 PC Wallpapers (x3)
 Mobile Phone Wallpapers (x8)
 Odyssia Symphonic Trance (OST)

Users can save an additional 20% with the Deluxe Bundle (Game + Deluxe Pack) or the Complete Deluxe Bundle Edition Bundle (Game + Deluxe Pack + DLC).
